name: Circular Dish with Thickened Rim and Bi-Disc Footring
summary: The interior of this thickly potted dish follows a continuous, parabolic curve; the exterior displays a thickened lip and a wide, straight-cut footring in the shape of a jade bi disc (though it should be noted that “bi-disc shaped footring” is a modern, rather than an ancient, characterization of the shape).
